item.title: Three years after blaze, Black Walnut cafe reopens in Wortley Village
item.description: It took 1,035 days. Red tape and road construction pushed back the reopening for months. But the Black Walnut is officially back in business three years after the beloved Wortley Village café was destroyed in an overnight arson attack.
